reachable.note: NOT imported by the script — reached on-chain via the inline ILiveYieldStrategy interface. Holds the two-phase totalWithdrawal logic: WAITING_PERIOD=24h, EXECUTION_WINDOW=48h, TOTAL_DURATION=72h, WithdrawalStatus enum {None,Initiated,Executable,Expired}, _initiateWithdrawal, WithdrawalInitiated event. This is the authoritative source for what the script's calls do.

Likely concrete deployed type. market() reverts on all three live addresses, ruling out ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy; consistent with the plain ERC4626 strategy. Exact concrete type does not alter the closure (two-phase logic is in the AYieldStrategy base).

inlineInterfaces.name: ILiveYieldStrategy
inlineInterfaces.note: Deliberately minimal — the script comment states the deployed bytecode predates the EnumerableSet client refactor, so it avoids importing the in-repo AYieldStrategy and the newer getAuthorizedClients/authorizedClientCount getters that revert on-chain. Only totalWithdrawal is state-changing; the rest are preflight view calls.

onChain.note: Passed as the `client` arg to every totalWithdrawal / principalOf / withdrawalStates call. Snapshotted client whose principal is being withdrawn — the script asserts it is the only principal-holding client. owner() == 0xCad1a78... (same deployer ledger).
Ledger signer (HD path m/44'/60'/46'/0/0). In preview impersonated via vm.startPrank; in broadcast the actual tx sender. Asserted == strategy.owner() per strategy (preflight onlyOwner gate).
Canonical mainnet USDC; token arg; asserted == YIELD_STRATEGY_USDC.underlyingToken().

offChainState.note: Cited in a source comment as the provenance of the strategy addresses, but the script does NOT read it (no vm.readFile / fs access). Addresses are hardcoded constants. foundry.toml grants read-write on ./server/deployments, but this script writes nothing. No broadcast log is consumed by any node post-script (jsChain empty). Broadcast variant will emit a forge broadcast/ run-latest.json under broadcast/ as a normal side effect of --broadcast, but no JS chain reads it.

cluster.note: STRONGEST link. The script's own doc mandates story 055 (set 2) re-call the SAME totalWithdrawal in [executableAt, executableAt+48h] to drain. No Initiate... companion 'Execute' script or migrate:ss-execute-mainnet npm key exists yet (grep for story 055 / ExecuteYieldStrategy returns nothing actionable). This entry leaves all three strategies in WithdrawalStatus.Initiated; if set 2 is not run inside the 72h window the windows Expire and funds stay put — a half-configured-state risk worth the auditor's attention.

Same two-phase totalWithdrawal(token, PHUSD_STABLE_MINTER) initiate pattern on the DOLA + USDC strategies. Establishes the precedent for this script's flow; useful as the reference implementation the auditor diffs intent against.

The phase-2 'execute' counterpart of the rebalance flow — calls totalWithdrawal again within the window to drain. Closest existing template for what the missing story-055 set-2 execute script must look like; concrete model for window timing and the funds-to-owner branch.
Two-phase totalWithdrawal initiate on the AutoPool YieldStrategy (DOLA). Same _initiateWithdrawal mechanic, different strategy address; corroborates the 24h-window semantics.
Phase-2 execute counterpart (unpause + totalWithdrawal, funds to owner). Shows the unpause-before-execute step set-2 will likely also need.
Another two-phase totalWithdrawal initiate (AutoUSDC strategy). Same mechanic; lower priority — different strategy, only the minter client is shared by convention.
Phase-2 execute counterpart for AutoUSDC. Same window/drain template.

notes: Shallow Solidity closure: the script imports only forge-std. All audited behavior is reached on-chain through the inline ILiveYieldStrategy interface, whose two-phase semantics are defined in the nested-submodule lib/vault/src/AYieldStrategy.sol.

Live-fork corroboration passed for all three strategies: every NON-NEGOTIABLE preflight assert (owner==deployer, underlyingToken==token, !paused, principal>0, status==None) currently holds at block 25232709. Initiation is valid right now.

Side-effect surface of the broadcast variant: exactly three state-changing calls (one totalWithdrawal per strategy), each transitioning the (token, minter) withdrawal state None -> Initiated and emitting WithdrawalInitiated. No token transfers in this phase.

Half-configured-state watch: this is phase 1 of a 2-phase migration whose phase-2 (story 055) script does not yet exist in the repo. Initiating without a committed executor leaves three 24h windows that must be drained within 72h or they Expire.
